overview.description: The Innovator U.S. Small Cap Power Buffer ETF - February (KFEB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund aims to participate in the price movement of the iShares Russell 2000 ETF, up to a predetermined cap, while buffering the first 15% of losses over a one-year period. The fund is actively managed, using FLEX options and collateral to provide exposure. KFEB was launched on Feb 3, 2025 and is issued by Innovator.
